title: Durchsuchungen nach Brandanschlag im September 2025 auf Berliner Stromnetz

extraction.summaryEn: Police searched several homes and properties in Berlin, Hamburg, North Rhine-Westfalia and Brandenburg over an arson attack on power pylons in September 2025 that caused a large blackout in Berlin. Four suspects aged 28, 31, 35 and 36 are under investigation for sabotage.
